searchText: ~500 Mgas/s is already slower? it has to be, the blocks there are from a week ago This is also my guess, but I wanted to confirm. I've seen a screenshot previously with rate ~900 Mgas/s around 5M block. What I found curious is that the address does not have a transaction included in that block, it has this transaction <https://etherscan.io/tx/0x4622b329ef3a86f407eadf56d336d59262afc97262b2e79a965666054ab2c03d> with nonce 34845 exactly in position 0 as in the error, but int he previous block. So from here it looks as though you're trying to process the block twice Could be an off by one error while first importing blocks **AllCoreDevs in 30 minutes** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/407 Stream: https://youtu.be/Kk-kZXazi18 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 how do I make sure Besu team can be involved in EIP-4444 working session? We decided to discuss it at the next ACD 😄 #easybutton Opened an issue to track conversation about post-merge historical data guarantees prior to the next ACD: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/417
